proposals.before: Initially, Nao Chi killed Min Wang, Ju people sought Min Wang son Fa Zhang, got him Grand Historian Tao home, for person irrigated garden.
proposals.after: Initially, Nao Chi killed Min Wang, Ju people sought Min Wang son Fa Zhang, got him Grand Historian Jiao home, for person irrigated garden.
proposals.reason: Literal wrongly renders 嬓 as Tao; idiomatic correctly uses Jiao.

proposals.before: Tao daughter pitied good treated him.
proposals.after: Jiao daughter pitied good treated him.
proposals.reason: Literal continues the Tao misreading of 嬓; should match Jiao.

proposals.before: Yan initially entered Qi, heard Hua yi person Wang Juan worthy, ordered army middle said 'surround Hua yi thirty li none enter', because Wang Juan reason.
proposals.after: Yan initially entered Qi, heard Hua yi person Wang Zhu worthy, ordered army middle said 'surround Hua yi thirty li none enter', because Wang Zhu reason.
proposals.reason: Literal misreads 蠋 as Juan; idiomatic correctly uses Zhu.

proposals.before: Soon after sent person told Juan said: 'Qi people much esteem your righteousness, I make you general, enfeoff you ten thousand households.'
proposals.after: Soon after sent person told Zhu said: 'Qi people much esteem your righteousness, I make you general, enfeoff you ten thousand households.'
proposals.reason: Literal continues Wang Juan for 蠋; should be Zhu.
Literal continues Juan for 蠋; should be Zhu.

proposals.before: Wang Juan said: 'Loyal minister not serve two lords, chaste woman not change two husbands.
proposals.after: Wang Zhu said: 'Loyal minister not serve two lords, chaste woman not change two husbands.
proposals.reason: Literal misreads 王蠋 as Wang Juan; should be Wang Zhu.

proposals.before: Qi perished grandees heard this, said: 'Wang Juan, commoner, righteousness not face north to Yan, moreover officials in position eating salary!'
proposals.after: Qi perished grandees heard this, said: 'Wang Zhu, commoner, righteousness not face north to Yan, moreover officials in position eating salary!'
proposals.reason: Literal misreads 王蠋 as Wang Juan; should be Wang Zhu.

decisions.reason: Chinese 太史嬓 names the Grand Historian as 嬓 (Jiao); literal Tao is a wrong reading, and the proposed Jiao matches the character and the idiomatic rendering.
Chinese 嬓女 is Jiao's daughter; literal Tao repeats the same misreading of 嬓, and Jiao is the correct name.
Chinese 王蠋 is Wang Zhu; literal Juan misreads 蠋, and the proposed Zhu is the correct reading used in the idiomatic text.
The addressee in 謂蠋曰 is 蠋 (Zhu), not Juan; replacing Juan with Zhu corrects the name without changing the rest of the literal calque.
Subject 蠋固謝 is Zhu declining; Juan is the same misreading of 蠋 and should be Zhu.
Speech attribution 王蠋曰 names Wang Zhu as speaker; Wang Juan is an incorrect reading of 蠋.
The officials quote 王蠋; literal Wang Juan again misreads 蠋, and Wang Zhu is the accurate name.
